info.description:
Import the StrataDrive local environment and select it. Start the app/database using postman/README.md, then send requests in numerical order. There is one contracted business operation with 11 manual scenarios. Only 01 can create a standard synthetic row; its key is retained across resends. Replay/conflict require the captured receipt.

Canonical source: contracts/openapi.yaml; SHA256 55e4370470fb400d24311312661fcce045cc60f8c28866f4ee30569d13f2cc2e; prepared 2026-10-26. The schema URL in info is format metadata, not a request destination. No credentials are included. Error statuses 408/429/500/503 are documented in the canonical contract but are not forced by these normal manual requests. See postman/README.md for capacity, uncertainty and scoped cleanup guidance.
